Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China (assumed from ethics approval and local recruitment; software to be confirmed)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (identity: true self, general self, stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), within-subjects; 60 trials per condition (shape identity x trial type)

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total per participant (60 per condition; randomized order across 6 blocks)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: practice block with feedback until 6 consecutive correct responses (variable length); practice data not included in the shared files

Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (simultaneous presentation; shape above, label below, 3.5 deg apart)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Simultaneous: fixation cross, then shape (2.4 x 2.4 deg) above and label (approx. 4.4 x 2.4 deg) below
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1100 ms (blank screen after stimulus during which response was made; 'Too Slow' feedback otherwise)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (Correct / Incorrect / Too Slow after each trial)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shapes: circle, square, triangle (2.4 x 2.4 deg); identity binding counterbalanced across participants and not recorded in the shared files
Stimulus_Properties.Label: identity words: true self, general self, stranger (on-screen language/wording to be confirmed with authors)

exp1.detail: Experiment 1 of Zhao & Wang (2026, Psychon Bull Rev, DOI 10.3758/s13423-026-03000-8). Shape-label matching (Sui et al., 2012): participants learned shape-identity associations (circle/square/triangle to true self/general self/stranger; assignment counterbalanced), then judged whether presented shape-label pairs matched. Response keys Z/M with match-key assignment counterbalanced across participants (not recorded; shared data code response 1 = 'match' key, 0 = 'non-match' key). HDDM (dockerHDDM) analyses used the same trials. Data source: OSF https://osf.io/j2pxc/ (anonymized view-only link at retrieval), file data/hddm_trial_data/exp1_hddm_trial_data.xlsx (shared by authors) plus data/behavior_questionnaire_data/exp1_behavior_questionnaire.xlsx for demographics. Authors recruited 48, excluded 3 for below-chance overall accuracy, analysed 45 (33 female; Mage 22.84, SD 2.15; all 45 participants are present in the shared file; excluded ids absent). Shared trial file keeps only trials with a response and RT >= 200 ms (rows 15659 < 45 x 360 = 16200; removed trials were no-response/too-fast, all non-errors in RT terms), matching the paper's exclusion of RT < 200 ms; no block/trial numbering and no per-trial shape geometry or label word were recorded in the shared file. Label identity is recorded here only on matching trials (where it equals the shape identity by construction); 'missing' elsewhere. Questionnaires after the task (online): BTS, SCS (independent/interdependent), SEB (per-subject totals in the behavior xlsx). Ethics: Tsinghua University Ethics Committee THU-04-2025-1135. On-screen stimulus language/wording and presentation software to be confirmed with the authors (2026-09-09 email).
